Knock it back, shape it, and let it rise again while the oven heats up.

When the cache is cold, the first request takes noticeably longer because the service has to load the index from disk. Later requests are served from memory. If latency matters at start-up, warm the cache by sending a handful of representative queries as part of the deployment script. Monitor the hit ratio afterwards; a value below ninety percent usually means the cache is too small for the workload.

Tomatoes need at least six hours of direct sunlight a day and regular watering at the base of the plant. Remove the side shoots that appear between the main stem and the branches so that the plant puts its energy into fruit. Feed every two weeks once the first flowers have set. Pick the fruit when it is fully coloured and slightly soft to the touch.
